description: User-facing filter VALUE synonyms -> the real stored value(s). The KEY side (which column a term filters) is handled by filter_aliases.json; this is the VALUE side. A target may be a single string or a list of candidates; the resolver keeps the FIRST candidate that actually appears in that column's schema `possible_values` (so the schema stays the source of truth and the same synonym works across columns whose 'completed' value differs, e.g. change.status_name=CLOSED vs release.state=Complete). Matching is case-insensitive and folds spaces/underscores/hyphens. Entries under `by_column` win over `global`.
